checks.name: root-cause-evidence
checks.detail: Two defects behind 'too stupid' output, both evidenced live. (1) Budget.parse_errors was cumulative+never-reset at max 3 — a run making progress died on 3 SCATTERED fumbles (live run1: steps interleaved with 3 parse errors -> 'too many parse errors'). (2) The local model emits flattened tool calls {"action":"tool","tool":"fs_write","path":..,"content":..} with params at top level, so action.get('args')=={} and every fs_write hit '[Errno 21] Is a directory' (workspace root) — captured raw via direct LM Studio call. Net: the agent could not write a single file and fabricated success ('Due to filesystem restrictions I couldn't write the file').

checks.name: regression-test-red
checks.detail: Stashed the 4 source fixes (kept new tests): test_budget_resets_consecutive_parse_errors_on_progress, test_budget_record_parse_success_clears_streak, test_loop_survives_scattered_parse_errors_across_progress all FAILED — the integration test showed 'failed == completed' (old code dies at the 2nd cumulative fumble).

checks.name: regression-test-green
checks.detail: After fix all GREEN. Consecutive-reset semantics (budget), scattered-fumble survival (loop), and normalize_action shapes (a)flattened-args (b)name-as-action (c)double-encoded-dict-args, plus canonical/final no-op guard.

checks.name: live-end-to-end
checks.detail: Same hard prompt, real LM Studio (local-model). BEFORE: 8 tool.failed, 3 parse errors, delegation flailing, 280s, file NEVER written. AFTER: 1 parse error (recovered), 3 clean steps, fs_write OK + fs_read OK + final, 28s, 0 failures. Wrote text_stats.py (1094B) — verified it imports and analyze() returns the spec'd dict with correct case-insensitive/punctuation-stripped top-3.

checks.name: adversarial-review
checks.detail: Workflow review-loop-robustness-fix, 12 agents, find->verify. 1 confirmed (medium): normalize_action case-(c) leaves a double-encoded NON-dict args (array/scalar) as a string -> tool_node coerces to {}. Accepted as known limitation: non-regressive (pre-existing), the suggested fix is a no-op for dispatch (tool_node rejects string AND list to {} identically), our tool-args contract is always an object so list-as-args is malformed with no sound mapping, and it self-heals via the tool-error retry. 8 findings dismissed incl. _sync_budget omitting consecutive (end-of-run value irrelevant; persisted budget carries it), delegate/final envelopes not corrupted, canonical no-op confirmed.

checks.name: full-suite
checks.detail: python3 -m pytest -m 'not integration_llm' -p no:randomly -q — all pass (354), 1 skipped. Touched-area gate (discipline+orchestrator+supervisor) green.

checks.name: ruff
checks.detail: ruff check discipline/ orchestrator/loop.py supervisor/graph.py tests/ — clean.

risk_note: Accepted known limitation: double-encoded non-dict tool args (e.g. args="[...]") degrade to empty args -> recoverable tool error, no sound normalization exists. Default max_parse_errors raised 3->8 (consecutive); AGENT_MAX_PARSE_ERRORS / AGENT_MAX_STEPS env knobs added for tuning without code change.
